archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / HIGH PRECISION TRADING TERMINAL
overview: Comprehensive design refinement guidelines for StockForge dark trading terminal. Preserves the authentic dark aesthetic while introducing softer panel depths, balanced micro-radii, refined contrast ratios, crisp skeleton shimmers, mobile-responsive table-to-card transformations, dynamic live brand CSS variable styling, and a clean Admin AI agent proposal card interface with explicit confirmation flows.

dynamic_css_vars.instruction: Admin Site settings live theme picker updates --a and --a2 on documentElement or root wrapper, re-rendering accent buttons, badges, highlights, and chart strokes immediately.

entry_surfaces./: split terminal hero — live market ticker + headline left, real-time quote preview cards and volume gauge right
entry_surfaces./login: branded terminal login — key market stats & live status left, high-contrast terminal auth card right
entry_surfaces./admin: control center hub — operational status & system toggles top, live site settings & AI agent command deck main

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B) — grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4
grids.terminal_layout: Header (h-14 fixed z-50 glass) + Sub-ticker banner + Main content area with px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 + Mobile bottom navigation dock
grids.mobile_tables: Convert wide tabular data (markets, watchlist, admin users, orders) to card stacks below 768px (md breakpoint) with key metric pills.

visual_enhancers.panel_style: sf-panel: rounded-xl bg-[#0D131F]/90 border border-[#1E293B]/80 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-200 hover:border-slate-700/80
visual_enhancers.kicker_style: text-xs font-mono font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[var(--a,#00E5FF)]
visual_enhancers.button_style: sf-btn: rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-150 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50
visual_enhancers.input_style: sf-input: rounded-lg bg-[#0B101B] border border-[#1E293B] px-3.5 py-2 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[var(--a,#00E5FF)] focus:border-[var(--a,#00E5FF)]
visual_enhancers.skeleton_shimmer: bg-slate-800/40 relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-translate-x-full before:animate-[shimmer_1.6s_infinite] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-slate-700/20 before:to-transparent rounded-lg

fields: section_toggles (inventory, markets, media, scanner, advisor, paper_trading, tiers)
site_settings.live_theme: Applying changes immediately injects CSS variables to root and syncs to backend

proposal_card_ux.rule: Zero direct mutations. Agent responses with actions MUST render an interactive Proposal Card.
card_elements: Action Title & Category Badge (Settings, User, Item, Banner)
Diff Summary (Old value vs Proposed value)
Destructive flag styling (Red border & warning icon for delete operations)

items_and_users_crud.items: Featured market items / signals CRUD with modal or inline edit and live state preview
items_and_users_crud.users: User management with role toggle (admin/user), tier upgrade/downgrade, and safe delete with confirmation modal

motion.page_transitions: Fade-in with subtle y-translation (opacity 0 -> 1, y: 6px -> 0px, duration 0.2s)
motion.micro_interactions: Button active scale (0.98), badge hover pulses, tab switch indicator slide

accessibility.contrast_target: APCA & WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum on all body copy and interactive badges
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap transitions with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) or motion.div with reduced motion respect
accessibility.data_testids: All buttons, inputs, links, toggles, proposal cards, and metrics must include kebab-case data-testid tags

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the existing StockForge terminal look & feel, refining spacing from cramped margins to relaxed tailwind p-4/p-6/p-8 containers.
Refine all panel backgrounds using .sf-panel styling with subtle rounded-xl and translucent borders for cohesive modern depth.
Add the site-wide Announcement Banner at top of page when enabled in settings with customizable tones (info, warning, alert).
In Admin Control Centre, provide high-polish settings tabs: Site Settings (with color pickers updating --a and --a2 in real-time), Featured Items CRUD, Users management, and AI Agent Chat.
Ensure AI Agent chat strictly wraps actionable proposals in Proposal Cards containing Apply and Dismiss buttons, showing clear destructive visual warning for user or item deletions.
Ensure mobile viewports have smooth bottom nav docks and convert all horizontal overflow tables into clean metric cards.
Always use sonner for toasts mounted at bottom-right.
Ensure strict TypeScript typing throughout with proper data-testid attributes on all interactive controls.
